description: This file defines a jQuery plugin for creating a customizable, accessible virtual dialog popup, including methods for initialization, positioning, focus management, and hiding the dialog.

methods.name: virtualDialog
methods.description: Main function to initialize or invoke methods of the virtual dialog plugin based on arguments.

methods.name: __init
methods.description: Creates and displays the virtual dialog with specified options.

methods.name: __prepare
methods.description: Sets up event listeners for key handling and creates the live region for accessibility if it doesn't exist.

methods.name: _keyHandler
methods.description: Handles keyboard events for tab navigation and escape to close the dialog.

methods.name: __focusManager
methods.description: Stores and restores focus to the element that initiated the dialog.

methods.name: __position
methods.description: Centers the dialog on the viewport.

methods.name: hide
methods.description: Hides and removes the dialog, restoring focus.
